recommendations: Emission cap of 800 tCO2 is infeasible given the available renewable capacity. IIS confirms emission_cap[total] and renewable_penetration_minimum are jointly binding during hours 8-10 when solar is unavailable.
Recommend relaxing emission_cap_tCO2 from 800 to at least 1100 tCO2 (20% relaxation as first attempt).
Alternatively, reduce renewable_penetration_min from 0.70 to 0.60 to allow more thermal dispatch during low-solar hours.
If both relaxations still produce INFEASIBLE, consider adding battery storage or dispatchable renewable capacity (RESTRUCTURE).
